findings.description: Secret screening misses quoted JSON credential assignments, encrypted private-key markers and NFKC token representations. At src/server/src/ai/gateway/index.ts:28-31, the credential regex does not allow the JSON label's closing quote, encrypted PEM is omitted, and redaction uses original rather than normalized text. Both independent reviewers reproduced dispatch of synthetic examples with mocked Prisma/transport and no external calls. Reject high-confidence credential/private-key representations before attempts, consistently screen/redact normalized lower-confidence tokens without rewriting grounding IDs, and add adversarial cases across narrative, diff, criterion and evidence fields. Live provider mode remains disabled; no real credential disclosure is claimed.

An oversized advertised Content-Length is rejected at transport.ts:41-42 before the body reader is acquired. Finally at lines61-63 clears timer/removes the deadline listener without aborting or cancelling the unread body. Both independent synthetic open-stream probes returned INVALID_OUTPUT while bodyCancelled=false and transportSignalAborted=false. Abort/cancel every early transport rejection with bounded cleanup; verify advertised and actual overflow, invalid UTF-8, and deadline during reads leave no live body. No real network call was made.

findings.requirement: NFR-OBS-001; NFR-RES-001; safe provider usage accounting
findings.description: decode in gateway/index.ts:92-100 validates advisory content before returning envelope usage; analyze at lines189-203 assigns usage only after successful decoding. Both independent mocked gateway probes recorded provider-reported 321 prompt/123 completion/444 total/12 cached for valid output, but four null usage fields when only role content became malformed JSON. Validate/retain safe envelope usage independently of content acceptance, including refusal, truncation and invalid-schema failures; keep genuinely absent/invalid usage unknown and never retain raw output.

findings.requirement: REQ-REV-014; clear oversized-context explanation and manual fallback
findings.description: PatchRiskAssistant.tsx:77-80 discards the safe INPUT_LIMIT reason from a422 AI_UNAVAILABLE response and displays generic unavailability/try-again-later guidance. An independent in-memory TSX/JSDOM probe confirmed that exact feedback while manual/analyze controls remained enabled. Map allowlisted size-limit reasons to explicit guidance that the complete context exceeds AI limits and manual review remains available; preserve safe correlation references and test diff/total-context limit feedback. No component source was edited by the reviewer.

The six ai-save-{new-revision,approval,drop-reclaim}-{event-first,save-first} cases at patch-risk.integration.ts:278-286 finish the first transaction before initiating the competing operation. Save-first also refreshes command coordinates before the lifecycle event. Passing these sequential cases does not prove lock-wait/stale-version behavior under contention. Initiate both operations with their original captured coordinates while one holds the relevant lock, prove the second is waiting, then release and assert allowed commits/conflicts plus atomic business/activity/notification outcomes. No production race failure is established; six matrix concurrency obligations remain unresolved despite green selectors.
